learning_outcomes.text: Know and understand the basic methodologies and rules of drawing.

Ability to apply knowledge and understanding to the modeling and graphic representation of machine elements, systems and plants with reference to national and international standards, with particular regard to the needs of the biomedical field.
Acquire independent judgment in reading and evaluating design drawings.
Be able to learn the use of new developing drawing tools.
Be able to communicate ideas through graphic representation.

syllabus_topics: Introduction to technical drawing. Drawing as a graphic language for communicating technical information. Drawing's place in the product life cycle. The digital prototype, technical drawing and mechanical design, 1 ECTS.

Standardization and unification in technical drawing: scales, sheet formats, lines and graphic symbolism, Methods of representing shapes and volumes: orthogonal projections, sections, criteria and methods of dimensioning. Functional, manufacturing and testing dimensioning, 1 ECTS.

Overview of main mechanical processes. Dimensional tolerances and ISO system. Geometric tolerances. Overview of tolerance application in industrial design. Surface roughness: main unified parameters, indications in drawing, 1 ECTS.
Threaded connections: representation of screws and bolts. Non-threaded couplings, 1 ECTS.
Examples of graphic representation in the biomedical field, 1 ECTS.
Graphic representation works (in traditional manner and using 2D and 3D CAD software, with representation of mechanical and/or prosthetic components), 1 ECTS.
teaching_methods: Realization of graphic works with CAD software

assessment_methods.method: Discussion and verification of graphic works presented in class and completed during the course

assessment_rules: The final evaluation consists of a discussion and verification of the graphic works presented in class and completed during the course, followed by a final oral discussion. The oral discussion will start from the completed graphic works and cover all topics addressed. The objective is to verify students' ability to interpret graphic works and communicate fundamental information in the field of industrial engineering and mechanical design.
bibliography: E. Chirone, S. Tornincasa, Disegno Tecnico Industriale, vol. I e II, ed. Il Capitello.
Supplementary material provided by the lecturer.
Commercial 3D CAD software freely available to students.
degree: Laurea in Ingegneria Medica classe L-9 R Ingegneria industriale
